caption: The image features a square piece of woven textile displayed on a plain, light-colored background. The textile is composed of a repeating geometric pattern consisting of squares and rectangles. The color scheme of the textile utilizes shades of blue and white; the blue elements form block shapes that are framed and separated by a network of white woven threads. The pattern is symmetrical, with each blue block containing smaller internal grids surrounded by white, and the white sections forming lattice-like connections between the blue blocks. The entire textile is slightly irregular along its edges, indicating it is a fabric sample. There are no additional objects visible in the image besides the woven textile and the plain background.
